tools.name: find_design
tools.description: Searches the Minerals shelf of design libraries and tools. Applies when your person asks for, or you are about to choose or make yourself, a UI component, block, texture, pattern, background, illustration, animation, icon set, typeface, colour system, sound or design reference, or asks to change one

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Returns the pull for a ref from find_design. Applies once your person has chosen a listing or an item. tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Records that what get_listing returned was not used after all. Applies only then: a pull that went through needs no report. The curator reads the reports to judge what stays listed. Returns one line that says it was recorded.

tools.name: offer
tools.description: Gives the exact words for one choice, Yes or Not now, about one free item or one listing. Applies when one result of find_design clearly leads.
